issue.title: Record the Day strip decision (decisions:day-strip-shows-the-days-facts)

task_type_fields.proposed_change:
Proposed by bob-cli-bp.2 note #1, bob-cli-bp.3 note #1, bob-cli-bp.4 note #1, bob-cli-bp.5 note #1, and bob-cli-bp.6 note #1 (epic bob-cli-bp, plan plan:202610/daily_note_day_strip.md). Add the immutable decision strand `decisions/day-strip-shows-the-days-facts.md` (keyword "The Day Strip Shows The Day's Facts, Never Targets"), shaped like the existing decisions strands, with `/sase_memory_write`.

- Applies to: bob-ledger-tools and bob-cli.
- Claim: the Day strip shows the note's own day as facts, never targets (no deltas, percentages, goals, streaks, or status colours); it renders virtually after a canonical daily note's last line in Live Preview and is never written to the file; bob owns every number; it spawns `bob stats` only when it is on screen, the data has changed, and it has aged.
- Why: the research's placement and data evidence (a template fence would reach 26 of 1,169 daily notes; a virtual mount reaches all), and it refines the prior Stats research's R9 ("daily is where they become targets").
- Rejected alternatives: a template-written fence, a status-bar or sidebar variant, numbers written into notes or vault caches, a Reading-view bottom mount (the fragile path; reading_view=no shipped).
- Cost: one CodeMirror StateField block-widget pattern, plus a refresh policy separate from the Stats page.
- Reopens when: Bryan finds himself working to move its numbers, wants a mobile surface, or needs it written into notes.
- Evidence: research:202610/daily_note_day_strip/daily_note_day_strip.md, bob-cli docs/stats.md#day-strip (41afa14b), bob-cli 0fc6ebfa, bob-plugins 6ce2e17/38b6b1b/5f1df8b/af1e691 and the 1.67.1 mount fix from the bob-cli-bp landing.

The epic selected decision_record=no automatically (planner default, no human review), not by human rejection; no memory was changed during the epic or its landing. The glossary half is a separate bead. Run sase memory init only when implementing with appropriate authorization.
